func SortNumbers(numbers string) string {

func DecodeCyclic(s string) string {
    hash := map[string]string{
        "AAA": "a",
        "AAB": "b",
        "AAC": "c",
        "AAD": "d",
        "AAE": "e",
        "AAF": "f",
        "AAG": "g",
        "AAH": "h",
        "AAI": "i",
        "AAJ": "j",
        "AAK": "k",
        "AAL": "l",
        "AAM": "m",
        "AAN": "n",
        "AAO": "o",
        "AAP": "p",
        "AAQ": "q",
        "AAR": "r",
        "AAS": "s",
        "AAT": "t",
        "AAU": "u",
        "AAV": "v",
        "AAW": "w",
        "AAX": "x",
        "AAY": "y",
        "AAZ": "z",
        // Add more mappings as needed
    }

    var decoded strings.Builder
    for i := 0; i < len(s); i += 3 {
        group := s[i : i+3]
        if val, ok := hash[group]; ok {
            decoded.WriteString(val)
        }
    }

    return decoded.String()
}

    vowels := map[rune]struct{}{
        'a': {},

    }

    consonants := map[rune]struct{}{
        'b': {},
        'c': {},
        'd': {},
        'f': {},
        'g': {},
        'h': {},
        'j': {},
        'k': {},
        'l': {},
        'm': {},

        'H': {},
        'J': {},
        'K': {},
        'L': {},
        'M': {},
        'N': {},
        'P': {},
        'Q': {},
        'R': {},
        'S': {},
        'T': {},
        'V': {},
        'W': {},
        'X': {},
        'Y': {},
        'Z': {},
    }

    word = word[1 : len(word)-1]

    for i := len(word) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
        if _, isVowel := vowels[rune(word[i])]; !isVowel {
            if i > 0 && i < len(word)-1 {
                if _, isConsonant1 := consonants[rune(word[i-1])]; isConsonant1 {
                    if _, isConsonant2 := consonants[rune(word[i+1])]; isConsonant2 {
                        return string(word[i])
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return ""
}

import (
	"math/big"
	"strings"
)

func Simplify(x, n string) bool {
	xParts := strings.Split(x, "/")
	nParts := strings.Split(n, "/")
	num1 := new(big.Int)
	num1.SetString(xParts[0], 10)
	denom1 := new(big.Int)
	denom1.SetString(xParts[1], 10)
	num2 := new(big.Int)
	num2.SetString(nParts[0], 10)
	denom2 := new(big.Int)
	denom2.SetString(nParts[1], 10)

	result := new(big.Rat).SetFrac(num1, denom1)
	result.Mul(result, new(big.Rat).SetFrac(num2, denom2))

	return result.Denom().Cmp(big.NewInt(1)) == 0
}

func XOrY(n, x, y int) int {
    primeMap := map[int]int{
        2: x,
        3: x,
        5: x,
        7: x,
        11: x,
        13: x,
        17: x,
        19: x,
        23: x,
        29: x,
        31: x,
        37: x,
        41: x,
        43: x,
        47: x,
    }
    
    if val, ok := primeMap[n]; ok {
        return val
    }
    
    return y
}

data.program:
import (
	"strings"
)

func IntToMiniRoman(number int) string {
    roman := ""

    for number > 0 {
        switch {
        case number >= 1000:
            roman += "m"
            number -= 1000
        case number >= 900:
            roman += "cm"
            number -= 900
        case number >= 500:
            roman += "d"
            number -= 500
        case number >= 400:
            roman += "cd"
            number -= 400
        case number >= 100:
            roman += "c"
            number -= 100
        case number >= 90:
            roman += "xc"
            number -= 90
        case number >= 50:
            roman += "l"
            number -= 50
        case number >= 40:
            roman += "xl"
            number -= 40
        case number >= 10:
            roman += "x"
            number -= 10
        case number >= 9:
            roman += "ix"
            number -= 9
        case number >= 5:
            roman += "v"
            number -= 5
        case number >= 4:
            roman += "iv"
            number -= 4
        default:
            roman += "i"
            number--
        }
    }

    return strings.ToLower(roman)
}
